searchText: Could client teams please confirm whether or not their latest branches support validator custody? if so I'm happy to give it a test nimbus-geth bug validator custody impl update <@412614104222531604> for the next devnet could it be possible to run Electra with blobs for a few hours before switching to fulu? (Not 100% sure right now, but if I remember well blobs were activated only after fulu on the latest devnet). It will help to test IRL the switch blob/columns during sync, which may be a point of friction. sure we can activate fulu on monday if we launch it tomorrow Seems wise 😉 no inactivity leak during the whole weekend 🧌 FYI for the [peerdas-devnet-7 specs](https://notes.ethereum.org/@ethpandaops/peerdas-devnet-7), I changed the consensus specs release to [v1.5.0](https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/releases/tag/v1.5.0). It includes tests for the `DataColumnSidecarsByRoot` change we've decided on. Is it just the ssz container test? Yup just the ssz test.
